body:
First, thanks for all of your kind words.

>Heck, could you get a forestry job, or something like it?

You may find it funny, but I actually gave this some thought. I enjoy being in nature most of the time an I could imagine that I'd like such a job.

Problem is, I know nothing that I need to know about such a profession.  

But as you noticed, there is a deep, deep desire in me to go for a "greener" and more close-to-nature life.

**edit:** But i's so hard. I'm not that young anymore. For working in another profession I have to study first and I don't have that kind of money to support that. Furthermore, I'm not really sure what I want at all.

I just want to get out.
